duplicate_case_analysis.explanation: All 100 ground-truth DUPLICATE cases reference the primary bank transaction ID in the ground-truth file. The Phase 2.5 engine correctly resolves the primary bank transaction with the ledger as MATCH, explicitly records has_duplicate_submission = True and duplicate_group_id, and emits the duplicate bank record (e.g. SYNTH-BANK-DUP-000009) as DUPLICATE with duplicate_of_bank_txn_id = SYNTH-BANK-000009.
